CM CruiseMesh

Messaging beyond the internet.

CruiseMesh helps friends and family exchange messages nearby over a private Bluetooth mesh, with an optional internet relay when one is available.

Nearby first

Phones connect directly and can carry messages for one another.

Private by design

Friend cards and messages use end-to-end cryptographic identities.

Built for gaps

Messages wait safely when nobody has a connection and resume later.
